Kaplan-Meier plot of the cumulative percentage (1 - S(t)): CI bars, number at risk, p-value: the template km_cumulative

Source: R/tpl_docs.R
tfl_tpl_km_cumulative.Rd

The figure template km_cumulative, layout km: a variant of km (its defaults changed). Its program is one call, tfl_tpl(adtte, "km_cumulative", ...); a parameter a report leaves out takes the study standard's value, else the variant's default, else the layout's.

Parameters

ParameterTierStageDefaultMaps toWhat
timeusualcallAVALthe time variable (Surv(time, ...)), in 'time_unit'
time_unitusualcallmonthsthe time's unit: the call's first step converts the days to it; the x axis's title
censorusualcallCNSRthe censoring variable, 1 censored (Surv(time, censor == 0))
byrequiredcallsettings.treatmentthe curves' variable (survfit2(~ by), the colours)
y_percentothercallTRUETRUE: the y axis in % (scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()))
ciusualcallbarsthe confidence interval: band (add_confidence_interval()), bars at the axis's times (geom_errorbar())
ci_timesothercallthe bars' times (summary(fit, times = )); NULL: the x axis's breaks
conf_levelothercallthe interval's level (survfit2(conf.int = )); NULL: 0.95
conf_typeothercallthe interval's transformation (survfit2(conf.type = )); NULL: log
censor_marksusualcallFALSEthe censor marks (add_censor_mark())
median_lineusualcallFALSEthe line at 50% (geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5))
risk_tableusualcallTRUEthe number at risk under the curves (add_risktable(times = x_breaks))
risk_statisticsothercallthe risk table's rows (add_risktable(risktable_stats = )); NULL: n.risk
x_maxusualcallthe x axis's end (x_breaks <- seq(0, x_max, by = x_step)); NULL: the last time
x_stepusualcallthe x axis's step, the risk table's times; NULL: pretty()
x_labelusualcallthe x axis's title (labs(x = )); NULL: Time ()
y_minothercallthe y axis's start (coord_cartesian(ylim = )); NULL: 0
y_maxothercallthe y axis's end; NULL: 1
y_stepothercallkm.y_bythe y axis's step (scale_y_continuous(breaks = )); NULL: the figure style's
y_labelusualcallthe y axis's title (labs(y = )); NULL: by y_type
linetype_byothercallFALSETRUE: a line type an arm too (ggsurvfit(linetype_aes = TRUE))
legendusualcallbottomthe legend's place (theme(legend.position = )); NULL: inside
legend_titleothercallthe legend's title (labs(colour = )); NULL: none
pvalueusualcallTRUEthe log-rank p-value (add_pvalue())
pvalue_locationothercallannotationwhere the p-value goes (add_pvalue(location = ))
titleothercallthe figure's title (labs(title = ))
plotothercallany other figure setting (plot:): dpi, facet_by, add ..., over the template's

Example

fig <- tfl_tpl(adtte, "km_cumulative", by = "TRT01A", time_unit = "weeks")

See also

tfl_tpl(), tfl_tpl_help(), tfl_tpl_args(), tfl_templates()

Examples

tfl_tpl_help("km_cumulative", tier = c("required", "usual"))
#> km_cumulative (figure, layout km; variant of km; tflspec)

#>

#>   param        | effective (layer)              | what
#>   time         | AVAL (template)                | the time variable (Surv(time, ...)), in `time_unit`
#>   time_unit    | months (template)              | the time's unit: the call's first step converts the days to it; the x axis's title
#>   censor       | CNSR (template)                | the censoring variable, 1 censored (Surv(time, censor == 0))
#>   ci           | bars (variant:km_cumulative)   | the confidence interval: band (add_confidence_interval()), bars at the axis's times (geom_errorbar())
#>   censor_marks | FALSE (variant:km_cumulative)  | the censor marks (add_censor_mark())
#>   median_line  | FALSE (variant:km_cumulative)  | the line at 50% (geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5))
#>   risk_table   | TRUE (variant:km_cumulative)   | the number at risk under the curves (add_risktable(times = x_breaks))
#>   x_max        | - (template)                   | the x axis's end (x_breaks <- seq(0, x_max, by = x_step)); NULL: the last time
#>   x_step       | - (template)                   | the x axis's step, the risk table's times; NULL: pretty()
#>   x_label      | - (template)                   | the x axis's title (labs(x = )); NULL: Time (<unit>)
#>   y_label      | - (template)                   | the y axis's title (labs(y = )); NULL: by y_type
#>   legend       | bottom (variant:km_cumulative) | the legend's place (theme(legend.position = )); NULL: inside
#>   pvalue       | TRUE (variant:km_cumulative)   | the log-rank p-value (add_pvalue())
